method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation with editorial changes as at 26 June 2025 (last amendment in operation: Transfer of Land Amendment Act 2022, 7 August 2023); legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc_48587, retrieved 7 September 2026. With the Strata Titles (General) Regulations 2019, version 00-w0-00, in currency from 20 August 2026, mrdoc_49798, retrieved 19 October 2026 (regs 57, 58, 78-82, 86, 162).

scope: s 3(1) (notifiable variations), ss 14(8), 37(1), 44(2), 45(2), 46 (except (d)), 47(1)-(6), 83, 100(1)(c), (2), (2A), (4)(b), (6), (7), 102(5)-(6), 107(2), (4), 110, 120(2), 123(4)-(6), 126, 156(3)-(4), 157(3), 158-163, 164(2), 197(1)(a), (h), (3), 210(1)-(2); out: planning, scheme documents and registration, the developer's own duties, structural alterations, insurance, meetings, councils, strata managers, leasehold schemes, Part 11 variation, Part 12 termination, the Tribunal's orders in detail, machinery
seat: the owner of a lot in a strata titles scheme (and, before settlement, the buyer about to become one)
